llm.summary: This is a disclosed Chinese K12 chemistry lesson-planning skill for teachers, with scoped data use and no executable or hidden behavior found.

dimensions.detail: It is intentionally designed for mainland China Chinese K12 contexts and says deployments elsewhere must localize curriculum, legal, and crisis-help assumptions before use.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact contains Markdown and JSON reference/schema files only; no scripts, package installs, remote payload retrieval, or executable install behavior were found.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Instructions are bounded to chemistry lesson design for middle/high school teachers, explicitly exclude student-facing teaching, lab procedure design, exams, and unrelated subjects.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Persistent class data use is disclosed and scoped: it reads limited class workspace fields and writes lessonPlans as teacher-confirmed pending entries, with view/correct/delete/pause/export controls.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill’s capabilities align with chemistry lesson planning: it drafts lesson structures, question chains, curriculum alignment, experiment placement, and teacher-reviewed lesson-plan entries.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install for Chinese-language chemistry lesson planning in mainland China K12 settings. For use in another region or language, localize curriculum standards, minor-consent assumptions, and crisis/help channels before exposing it to teachers or students.
llm.findings:
[SQP-3] expected: The Chinese schema note is consistent with the skill’s stated Chinese K12 teacher context and documents the exact read/write scope for this distributed copy.
[SQP-3] expected: The grade-band defaults are Chinese K12 operational parameters, disclosed as defaults that users or guardians/teachers may adjust.
[SQP-3] expected: The hint-ladder guidance is Chinese-language pedagogical behavior for the same disclosed user population, not hidden or unrelated behavior.
[SQP-3] expected: The platform conventions explicitly disclose mainland China Chinese K12 assumptions and require localization before non-China deployment, including not outputting mainland emergency numbers when location is unknown.
[SQP-3] expected: The shared vocabulary is a Chinese terminology contract for this skill family and supports consistent data fields and consent controls rather than expanding authority.
